scope: Triaged the 20 newest RSS items. Examined selected Magazine articles and six recent Staff article bodies, concentrating on material game claims. Independent primary evidence was used; RSS was not used to corroborate itself. Live corrections remain the controller’s responsibility.

ufAwards.type: official dated award release; historical-date typo independently detected

byuPoll.type: independent university release on dated polls

postgameTranscript.type: published press-conference transcript, not audio independently replayed

recruitReporting.type: dated reporting with athlete's post and original interview link

mondayInjuryReporting.type: independent report of coach statement; not proof of exact PCL diagnosis

claims.claim: Florida beat then-No. 4 Ole Miss 52–28 in Gainesville on September 26, 2026; Florida became 4–0 overall and 2–0 in the SEC.
Florida had 302 rushing yards on 53 attempts and 196 passing yards on 23 attempts, with no sacks allowed.
Phil Trautwein is Florida’s offensive line coach, hired by Jon Sumrall.
Baugh: 29 carries, 142 yards, three rushing touchdowns. Clark: 12 carries, 126 yards, one rushing touchdown.
All three award recipients earned their first career SEC weekly honor.
claims.resolution: This is Baugh’s first Offensive Player award, not his first weekly award; he won Freshman of the Week in 2024.

claims.claim: Florida’s 374-yard rushing game against South Carolina occurred November 11, 2022.
claims.resolution: The date is November 12, 2022. The current UF award release repeats the wrong day; the contemporary box score and schedule establish the correct date.

claims.claim: The September 28 weekly awards went to Baugh for offense, Montgomery for special teams and Lovett for offensive line.
Montgomery: three kick returns, 128 yards, 74-yard long. Lovett: 69 snaps and an 85.1 PFF pass-blocking grade.
claims.note: PFF grading is attributed to UF’s release; proprietary PFF data was not independently audited.

claims.claim: Baugh reached five consecutive 100-yard rushing games, joining Emmitt Smith and Fred Taylor.
Before Ole Miss, only Baugh, Emmitt Smith and Fred Taylor had four consecutive 100-yard rushing games.
claims.resolution: The official bio calls Baugh the fourth player with four consecutive 100-yard games. Simplify the sentence to his entering streak; five consecutive games has a different historical comparison.

claims.claim: Chambliss threw yet another touchdown pass to make it 38–28.
claims.resolution: Only one passing touchdown; replace “yet another” with “a.”

claims.claim: Stockton had a 25-yard punt return.
claims.resolution: The play-by-play records 25 yards before a holding penalty; the statistical summary credits 16. Add penalty context when editing, rather than calling the raw play description false.

claims.claim: Woods forced a fumble on a sack, recovered by Myles Graham; DJ Coleman intercepted a pass at the Florida 5 in the fourth quarter.
Florida scored touchdowns on its first five second-half possessions.
Florida leads the Ole Miss series 14–13–1 after the game.
On September 27, Florida ranked No. 8 in AP and Coaches polls, rising 13 and 14 places respectively.
Cyion Smith committed to Florida September 26: Blountstown, class of 2028, safety, 6 feet 2, 175 pounds; Industry No. 279 overall and No. 30 safety.
claims.note: Ratings are a dated snapshot and may change. Interview quotations and the 70-prospect attendance claim were not fully audited.

claims.claim: An MRI confirmed a Grade 1 PCL sprain, according to confidential GatorBait sources.
claims.resolution: Public coach reporting supports favorable imaging and a non-long-term injury, but not the exact PCL diagnosis or grade. The editor must verify private source evidence. Do not call the claim false or independently verified based on this search.

claims.claim: The exact Monday Sumrall quotations about Tuesday practice and multiple injury updates.
claims.resolution: An independent report corroborates the favorable MRI statement. The full Monday recording or transcript was not reviewed; all quotations are not certified.

claims.claim: Saturday Sumrall and Woods quotations about Duke Clark, critical plays, the fumble, knee concerns and program progress.
claims.resolution: A retrieved press-conference transcript matches the checked Duke Clark, knee, critical-play and program-progress remarks and Woods’ recovery description. Original audio was not played and every quotation was not exhaustively compared.

claims.claim: Every national offense ranking, career-record position, preseason publication rating, remaining opponent record and historical movie quotation in the cover column.
claims.resolution: Core game facts are verified. These ancillary claims need further dated evidence; do not label the whole column triple-checked.

claims.claim: A generic native Staff account does not establish that an article lacks a named writer or photographer.
claims.resolution: The 10 Thoughts body explicitly credits Chris Spears. Galleries credit his photography. Preserve these named credits; the webmaster owns the account-attribution audit.
